answer: Submitting an answer locks 14 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The garden escrow is released only against a gale receipt, and the vault audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 169 aliases means carrying 129 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 7 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
